Condition : 1 - Reason (Condition 3)
The details submitted pursuant to condition 3 (Samples of materials) of planning permission 00248/319-327/P8 dated 15/12/2011for the erection of a new mixed use building (4-storeys plus penthouse level) comprising of A1 retail use on the ground floor and 16 residential units to the upper floors with basement level car parking and associated landscaping on the pavement/highway), are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
